column1: #   phy_init   data/phy   0xf000      4KB         RF calibration (do not touch)
#   - factory vs cardstore split: more/larger videos -> bigger factory;
#     more cards -> bigger cardstore (full card ~33KB each). Total must fit
#     16MB minus header offset; factory must be 0x10000-aligned
#   - NOTE: after ANY change here you MUST erase the whole flash before
#       pio run -t erase   then   pio run -t upload
#   - IMPORTANT: keep this file ASCII-only (PlatformIO parses it with the
#     system locale encoding; non-ASCII comments break checkprogsize).
